item.title: CoPlane: $14 Million Seed Funding Closed To Modernize Enterprise Back-Office Systems
item.description: CoPlane, an AI-native enterprise software company focused on overhauling back-office operations for large organizations, announced that it has raised a $14 million seed round led by Ribbit, with additional participation from Stripe, Optum Ventures, and Terrain. The company aims to replace legacy ERP systems with a unified AI-driven platform that streamlines finance, supply chain, and operational workflows.

item.title: Federated Hermes: $320 Million Raised In First Close For Sixth Private Equity Co-Investment Fund
item.description: Federated Hermes has launched the sixth vintage of its flagship Private Equity Co-investment series, PEC VI, securing approximately $320 million in initial commitments as the firm continues expanding its lower mid-market buyout strategy. The new vehicle follows PEC V, which closed at $486 million in 2023, reflecting ongoing momentum across the firm’s global private equity platform.

item.title: AI One: $7 Million Series A Closed To Scale Enterprise AI Infrastructure
item.description: AI One has raised $7 million in Series A funding, bringing its total capital secured to $11 million as the company ramps up work with Fortune 500 enterprises adopting AI at scale. The announcement was made by co-founder and CEO Conor Twomey, who said the new financing will help organizations move beyond pilots and begin treating AI as critical infrastructure.

item.title: Interface: $3.5 Million Seed Funding Raised To Build AI Operations Layer For Energy Companies
item.description: Interface, a startup developing an AI-powered operations platform for the energy sector, has closed a $3.5 million seed round led by Defy.vc with participation from Precursor Ventures, Rock Yard Ventures, Entrepreneurs First, Transpose Platform, and several angel investors.

item.title: Codenotary: $16.5 Million Secured To Expand Its AI Cybersecurity And Trust Automation Platform
item.description: Codenotary, a company known for its AI-driven cybersecurity and software supply chain trust solutions, announced that it has secured $16.5 million in new financing from a mix of existing and new investors. The investment will accelerate the company’s product development initiatives and global expansion efforts as demand increases for trust automation, secure cloud computing, and real-time visibility across distributed software environments.

item.title: S&P Global: $1.8 Billion Acquisition Of With Intelligence Completed To Expand Private Markets Capabilities
item.description: S&P Global has finalized its acquisition of With Intelligence for $1.8 billion, marking one of the company’s most significant moves to broaden its presence in private markets data and analytics. The transaction, first announced in October, brings together S&P Global’s extensive information infrastructure with With Intelligence’s proprietary data, workflow tools, and research focused on alternative investments.

item.title: Evolve Buys Guestworks Portfolio From Vacasa In Strategic Asset Purchase
item.description: Evolve has acquired Vacasa's Guestworks portfolio in a strategic asset purchase, bringing approximately 1,000 homeowners onto Evolve’s tech-enabled vacation rental management platform. The transaction expands Evolve’s position in the hybrid vacation rental management category. It reflects Casago’s continued focus on property management through its franchise-driven network following its acquisition of Vacasa earlier this year.

item.title: Juo: €4 Million Seed Round Raised To Build Infrastructure For Non-Digital Subscriptions
item.description: Juo, a Warsaw-based startup developing technology for physical-product subscription programs, has raised a €4 million seed round led by Market One Capital and Peak. Additional investors in the round include BADideas.fund, SMOK Ventures, FJ Labs, and Lakestar. Several individual investors, including Mark Ransford, Marek Gut, Maciej Zawadzinski, and Louis Pfitzner, also joined the funding round.

item.title: PowerUP Energy Technologies: €10 Million Raised To Scale Hydrogen Generator Production
item.description: PowerUP Energy Technologies has raised €10 million in Series A funding to accelerate the production and global deployment of its hydrogen fuel cell generators, a technology aimed at strengthening energy security across both defense and commercial markets.

item.title: BKN301: €21.5 Million Series B Closed To Advance Global Expansion And Product Innovation
item.description: BKN301 announced that it has closed a €21.5 million Series B round to support the next stage of its global growth and product development. The round includes participation from Simest SpA, CDP Venture Capital SGR, Azimut Italia, FNDX VC, and Alisei Forinvestments of Aldo Fumagalli.
